cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll apologize for arriving late if you apologize for starting dinner without me. Let's agree the exchange before either of us begins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd settle for ending the argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then specify what ends: no late-arrival jokes for the rest of the evening. My apology has to buy that much.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop bringing up the cold food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Matched terms. Say 'for the evening', please; I won't trade an all-night promise for a pause until dessert. Then we can apologize together.
